events.verdict: Griffin (DET) is established in the path of Lin (ATL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Lin (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Griffin (DET).
Pachulia (DET) firms up in the path of Huerter (ATL) and absorbs the contact on his screen.
Griffin (DET) engages with Lin (ATL) on the rebound but does not deliver contact to dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Bullock (DET) maintains a legal guarding position on Lin's (ATL) shot.
Bazemore (ATL) and Galloway (DET) engage and disengage during the screen.
Galloway (DET) is established in the path of Carter (ATL) when he gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Jackson (DET) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Jackson (DET) extends his arm into Lin (ATL) at the end of his drive and affects his ability to defend the shot.
Griffin (DET) and Len (ATL) engage and separate when trying to gain post position.
Pachulia (DET) establishes himself in the path of Lin (ATL) by firming up and absorbing the contact on the pick.
Len (ATL) makes contact with Jackson's (DET) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Len (ATL) establishes himself in the path of Bullock (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact on the pick.
Pachulia (DET) maintains a legal guarding position and cleanly dislodges the ball.
Carter (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position when he cleanly dislodges the ball from Jackson (DET) on his drive.
Griffin (DET) establishes himself in the path of Huerter (ATL) and gives him room to avoid the contact on the pick.
Griffin (DET) and Carter (ATL) briefly engage and disengage off ball.

During the driving shot attempt, Carter (ATL) swipes to dislodge the ball and makes hand on ball contact with Griffin (DET). Simultaneously, Len (ATL) jumps A to B and affects Griffin's (DET) shot attempt near the rim.
Pachulia (DET) and Len (ATL) engage and separate during the rebound attempt.
Pachulia (DET) commits a take foul on Lin (ATL).
Anderson (ATL) and Galloway (DET) engage and separate as they come off the screen.
Pachulia (DET) establishes himself in the path of Lin (ATL) and gives him room to avoid the contact on the screen.
Carter (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Jackson (DET).
Jackson (DET) commits a take foul on Lin (ATL) and after makes incidental foot to foot contact dislodging him from his legally obtained position.
Anderson (ATL) makes marginal contact with Galloway's (DET) body after his gather but does not affect his SQBR.
Anderson (ATL) makes clean ball contact on the tip out rebound.
